notes.title: Release date delayed
notes.notes:
[h1]Heya pixels![/h1]

We are doing our best to create something that was not there before. We have decided to [b]redesign a huge part of the game[/b] and this decision requires more time, so we are both sad and happy to announce the game release date delayed to make the game even better. 

So, what should you expect?
[olist]
[*] Better Design
[*] HQ Textures
[*] New Trailer
[*] Better Effects
[/olist]

[b]When? 20-29. January ~ 2021[/b] ːhappy_creepː
